import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate rectangular hollow frames (at least 3x3), and fill their interiors
    # with the checkerboard pattern; isolated nonzero colors specify fill colors.
    from collections import Counter
    # identify bounding boxes by color using boundary-contiguous rectangles
    colors={v for row in g for v in row if v}
    frames=[]
    for col in colors:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==col]
        if len(pts)<8: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        if all(g[r0][c]==col and g[r1][c]==col for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[r][c0]==col and g[r][c1]==col for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            frames.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,col))
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,col in frames:
        # use the dominant isolated color in space external to all frames
        framecells={(r,c) for a,b,x,y,k in frames for r in range(a,b+1) for c in range(x,y+1)}
        counts=Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in framecells)
        fill=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                g[r][c]=fill if ((r-r0-1+c-c0-1)%2==0) else 0
    # erase isolated markers
    framecells={(r,c) for a,b,x,y,k in frames for r in range(a,b+1) for c in range(x,y+1)}
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in framecells: g[r][c]=0
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
out=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
